title: Single-language block edits across orchestration boundaries
failure_signature: PowerShell backtick-newline escapes broke the outer JavaScript orchestration template before a shell call was made.
candidate_workaround: Use apply-patch for the exact semantic block or keep the transformation in one parser language with no layered newline escapes.
recurrence_guard: Never mix PowerShell backtick escapes inside a JavaScript template literal; verify that the outer orchestration source parses before assuming the nested command can run.
rollback: Retain the parser failure, confirm no shell call or file mutation occurred, and retry only with a single-language edit.
scope_boundary: Orchestration and patch transport only; it does not validate the evidence builder semantics.
